summary: Petition to the Central Elections Committee concerning the Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits.
notes: Freshness recheck found no final CEC merits ruling on this specific Damon video. ABC reported on Sep. 4 that the original Damon video now appears to have been deleted from Ben-Gvir's social output; exact press copies remain. Do not infer that deletion was caused by the petition or that it establishes a legal violation. Earlier rulings on different Ben-Gvir campaign videos remain non-transferable.
